claims.text: The hotel is set against the backdrop of the Han River and Mount Namsan.

findings.quote: set against the stunning backdrop of Han River and Mount Namsan

claims.text: The hotel is a 20-floor glass building on the slopes of Namsan in Hannam-dong.

findings.quote: a 20-floor glass structure nesting on the slopes of Namsan (Seoul’s most iconic mountain) in Hannam-dong

claims.text: The hotel is minutes from downtown Seoul, Myeongdong and Itaewon.

findings.quote: minutes from downtown Seoul, Myeongdong, and Itaewon

claims.text: The hotel is close to cultural attractions such as the Leeum Samsung Museum of Art and Bukchon Hanok Village.

findings.quote: close to bustling shopping districts as well as cultural attractions like Leeum Samsung Museum of Art, Bukchon Hanok Village and much more

claims.text: Guest rooms have interiors accented with Korean cultural inspiration.

findings.quote: offer stylish interiors accented with Korean cultural inspiration

claims.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of the Seoul skyline.

findings.quote: Unwind and relax in our modern rooms featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, offering magnificent panoramic views of the Seoul skyline.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has panoramic views of the Han River and Mount Namsan.

findings.quote: breathtaking panoramic views of the Han River and Mount Namsan

claims.text: Grand Club access includes a dedicated concierge, a daily breakfast buffet, and evening cocktails and canapes.

findings.quote: the exclusive space includes a dedicated concierge, daily breakfast buffet, and evening cocktails and canapes

claims.text: The indoor pool on the Garden Level has a nature-friendly interior with trees.

findings.quote: The indoor swimming pool at Grand Hyatt Seoul is located on the Garden Level. The nature-friendly interior, combined with the trees, creates an exotic atmosphere.

claims.text: In winter the outdoor pool becomes an ice skating rink.

findings.quote: an outdoor pool that transforms into an ice skating rink come winter

claims.text: 322 Sowol-ro is the hotel's gourmet alley, with four restaurants: Steak House, Teppan, Kauri and Tenkai.

findings.quote: Take a walk down 322 Sowol-ro, our unique gourmet alley where you’ll find four exquisite restaurants, each with its own distinct personality and cuisine: Steak House, Teppan, Kauri and Tenkai.

claims.text: The Gallery lounge has art, music and large floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: surrounded by the art, music, and natural light that floods the area through large floor-to-ceiling windows

claims.text: The hotel spreads across 23 landscaped acres, giving it the feel of a leisure resort in the heart of the city.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Seoul spreads across 23 landscaped acres—lending it the feel of a leisure resort in the heart of the city.

claims.text: The Club Olympus wellness center has a sauna, an indoor pool, an outdoor pool with a whirlpool, and squash and tennis courts.

findings.quote: The center features a sauna, indoor pool, outdoor pool with a whirlpool, as well as squash and tennis courts.

claims.text: The outdoor swimming pool overlooks the Han River.

findings.quote: Overlooking the Han River, the huge 35x14 m sized outdoor swimming pool

claims.text: The Spa has nine independent treatment suites and a European botanical garden concept.

findings.quote: Experience The Spa’s nine independent treatment suites and the European botanical garden concept

claims.text: Room decor includes black-and-white fish paintings, hanok photographs and geometric wood patterns reminiscent of bojagi wrapping cloths.

findings.quote: black-and-white fish paintings, hanok (traditional Korean houses) photographs, and geometric wood patterns reminiscent of bojagi (traditional Korean wrapping cloths)

claims.text: The hotel sits up a hill; the walk up is steep and takes about 20 minutes.

findings.quote: The ascent up the hill is steep and takes about 20 minutes if you’re walking at a brisk pace.

claims.text: Children under 13 are not allowed in the Grand Club Lounge during evening cocktails.

findings.quote: Please be informed that children under the age of 13 will be restricted from entering the Grand Club Lounge during evening cocktails.

claims.text: The hotel's kids' lounge is unsupervised.

findings.quote: Parents should be aware that the space is unsupervised.
